scope: Frontend-only shared PageHeader, Panel, Stat, and Stats layout ownership. Preserve current feature behavior and user-staged edits; no backend, full-product tracker, or generated source changes.

spacingOwners.Panel header inset: Panel; horizontal/top inset 16px mobile and 24px tablet/desktop; bottom edge owns 16px header-to-body separation
spacingOwners.Panel body inset: Panel only when bodyMode=inset; 16px mobile and 24px tablet/desktop; bodyMode=flush remains the compatibility default for tables/toolbars/pagers
spacingOwners.Panel caller section spacing: Panel semantic beforeGap/afterGap presets; caller may select section 24px or surface 16px, never provide a spacing literal
spacingOwners.Stats card-to-card and next section: Stats; semantic 16px grid gutter and one 24px trailing section gap

uiDesignContract.geometry: Panel caller-specific display/flexDirection/height/gridColumn stays geometry-only under a narrow typed prop; geometry does not create a new spacing scale.
uiDesignContract.typographyAndStates: Keep theme typography, min-width/long Vietnamese text, titles/actions wrapping, responsive grid, table/form state, and all permissions/data behavior unchanged.
uiDesignContract.doubleInsetRule: Panel body owns the inset only when bodyMode=inset. Existing flush table/content remains flush; do not combine Panel inset with child p16/p24. Header bottom owns the 16px separation when a titled inset body follows.
uiDesignContract.verification: Run TypeScript, layout fixtures/strict debt report, full verify, and browser measurements at representative 1280x900 and 390x844 viewports. Verify header/body/gutter values, no horizontal document overflow, form/table/dashboard rendering, and preserved staged diff. Strict may remain FAIL only for assigned W07-W25 migration debt; never report it as PASS.

preservationNote: At capture, components.tsx and all identified Panel caller modules already contained staged user work. Edits are constrained to the four shared owners, the typed layout bridge, and exact Panel spacing/geometry props at existing callsites; no staging or index rewrite is permitted.
